import os, resource, sys, json, tempfile, inspect, collections, hashlib, time
from pathlib import Path
os.environ.update(OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1', MKL_NUM_THREADS='1', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (512 * 1024**2, 512 * 1024**2))
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (45, 45))
root = Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0] = [str(root / p) for p in ('src', '.', 'plugins/tcad_artifact', 'plugins/curve_score', 'plugins/curve_figure_evidence')]
from scidiscovery.operations.catalog import compile_catalog
from scidiscovery.builtin_plugin import CORE_PLUGIN
from scidiscovery.general_science_plugin import PLUGIN as GENERAL
from curve_score.plugin import PLUGIN as CURVE
from tcad_artifact.plugin import PLUGIN as TCAD
from curve_figure_evidence.plugin import PLUGIN as FIGURE
from scidiscovery.artifact_agent.schema.common import canonical_json
from scidiscovery.artifact_agent.schema.artifact import ArtifactRegistration
from scidiscovery.artifact_agent.interfaces.mcp_local_worker import LocalWorkerMCPRouter
from tests.operations.test_m2_curve_analysis_boundary import _root, _compiler_plan, _compiler_objective, _bundle
from curve_score.curve_contract_compiler import CurveContractCompileInput, compile_curve_contract
from tests.operations.test_tcad_result_analysis import analysis_system, open_analysis, analysis_report, write_analysis
from tests.operations.test_minimal_figure_extraction import _request, _png
from curve_figure_evidence.figure_digitization_contract import FigureDigitizationRequest
from pydantic import ValidationError

started=time.monotonic()
catalog=compile_catalog((CORE_PLUGIN, GENERAL, CURVE, TCAD, FIGURE))
rows=[]
for name in catalog.operation_ids():
    op=catalog.operation(name)
    rows.append({'operation':name,'executor':op.spec.executor.kind,'input_validation':op.spec.input_validation.model_dump(mode='json') if op.spec.input_validation else None,
                 'guards':[g.model_dump(mode='json') for g in op.spec.guards],
                 'context_validators':[{'output':p.name,'validator':p.context_validator.model_dump(mode='json'),'sources':list(p.context_sources)} for p in op.spec.outputs if p.context_validator],
                 'digest':op.digest})
out={'catalog':rows, 'probes':[]}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='scid-responsibility-') as tmp:
    temp=Path(tmp)
    temp.joinpath('curve').mkdir()
    cat,runtime,instance,router=_root(temp/'curve')
    def register(name, value, schema):
        obj=runtime.artifacts.register(canonical_json(value), ArtifactRegistration(kind='fixture',schema_id=schema,payload_schema_version=1,media_type='application/json',creator=runtime.actor),idempotency_key=name)
        runtime.scheduler_bindings.bind(instance=instance.instance_id,namespace='artifact',name=name,object_id=obj.artifact_id)
    plan=_compiler_plan(); objective=_compiler_objective(); bundle=_bundle()
    register('plan',plan.model_dump(mode='json'),'scidiscovery.experiment-portfolio.v1')
    register('objective',objective.model_dump(mode='json'),'scidiscovery.research-objective.v1')
    wrong=objective.model_dump(mode='json'); wrong['objective_key']='different_objective'
    register('wrong_objective',wrong,'scidiscovery.research-objective.v1')
    register('reference',bundle.model_dump(mode='json'),'scidiscovery.curve-bundle.v1')
    router.call_tool('operation_invoke',dict(name='plan_review',operation_id='science.object.review.v1',inputs=[dict(port='experiment_plan',artifact_names=['plan'])],instruction='Review the synthetic plan.'))
    compiled=cat.operation('science.object.review.v1')
    reviewer=LocalWorkerMCPRouter(runtime.runs,operation_id=compiled.spec.operation_id,operation_digest=compiled.digest)
    opened=reviewer.call_tool('worker_open_assignment',{})
    Path(opened['output_directory'],'result.json').write_bytes(canonical_json({'schema_version':1,'handoff':{'verdict':'pass','summary':'Synthetic fixture.'},'payload':{'review_target':'experiment_portfolio','verdict':'pass','summary':'Synthetic fixture.'}}))
    assert reviewer.call_tool('worker_submit_result',{})['state']=='completed'
    review_name=router.call_tool('run_status',{'name':'plan_review'})['output_artifact_name']
    request=dict(name='contract_bad_input',operation_id='science.curve.contract.design.v1',instruction='Exercise the exact synthetic bindings.',inputs=[dict(port='research_objective',artifact_names=['wrong_objective']),dict(port='experiment_plan',artifact_names=['plan']),dict(port='experiment_review',artifact_names=[review_name]),dict(port='reference_bundle',artifact_names=['reference'])])
    admission=router.call_tool('operation_preflight',request)
    result={'probe':'curve_contract_cross_input_identity','preflight_admissible':admission['admissible']}
    if admission['admissible']:
        router.call_tool('operation_invoke',request)
        compiled=cat.operation(request['operation_id'])
        worker=LocalWorkerMCPRouter(runtime.runs,operation_id=compiled.spec.operation_id,operation_digest=compiled.digest)
        opened=worker.call_tool('worker_open_assignment',{})
        contract=compile_curve_contract(CurveContractCompileInput.model_validate({'experiment_key':'implementation_check','target_bindings':[{'target_key':'target_implementation','reference_series_key':'reference'}],'candidate_case_keys':['baseline'],'comparison_metric':'residual_rms'}),objective=objective,portfolio=plan,reference_bundle=bundle)
        Path(opened['output_directory'],'result.json').write_bytes(canonical_json({'schema_version':1,'handoff':{'verdict':'pass','summary':'Synthetic compiler output.'},'payload':contract.model_dump(mode='json')}))
        submitted=worker.call_tool('worker_submit_result',{})
        result.update(submission_state=submitted['state'],diagnostics=submitted.get('diagnostics'))
        from curve_score.science_operations import _curve_contract_context
        try:_curve_contract_context(contract.model_dump(mode='json'),{'experiment_plan':plan.canonical_json(),'research_objective':canonical_json(wrong),'reference_bundle':bundle.canonical_json()}, {})
        except Exception as error:result['direct_reason']=str(error)
    out['probes'].append(result)

    temp.joinpath('tcad').mkdir()
    system=analysis_system(temp/'tcad'); worker,opened=open_analysis(system)
    import tcad_artifact.project_packager as packager
    original=packager.validate_deck_review_against_project
    calls=[]
    def track(*args,**kwargs):
        calls.append([frame.function for frame in inspect.stack()[1:8]])
        return original(*args,**kwargs)
    packager.validate_deck_review_against_project=track
    try:
        write_analysis(opened,analysis_report())
        submitted=worker.call_tool('worker_submit_result',{})
    finally:packager.validate_deck_review_against_project=original
    out['probes'].append({'probe':'tcad_analysis_submit_rechecks_project_qualification','state':submitted['state'],'qualification_check_calls':len(calls),'stacks':calls})

    request=json.loads(_request(_png()))
    request.update(request_status='unresolved',unresolved_reasons=['Image identity has not been recovered.'])
    for key in ('plot_bbox','axis_calibration','series'):request.pop(key,None)
    for key in ('recovered_image_sha256','width','height','recovery_tool_version'):request['source'].pop(key,None)
    try:FigureDigitizationRequest.model_validate_json(canonical_json(request)); errors=[]
    except ValidationError as error:errors=[{'loc':list(e['loc']),'type':e['type']} for e in error.errors()]
    out['probes'].append({'probe':'unresolved_figure_requires_recovered_image_metadata','accepted':not errors,'errors':errors})

out['resources']={'elapsed_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'peak_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'address_space_limit_mib':512,'cpu_limit_seconds':45,'threads':1}
Path('/tmp/scid-responsibility-probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'operation_count':len(rows),'executor_counts':dict(collections.Counter(r['executor'] for r in rows)),'probes':out['probes'],'resources':out['resources']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

import os,resource,sys,json,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
os.environ.update(OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(512*1024**2,512*1024**2))
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(30,30))
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0]=[str(root/p) for p in ('src','.','plugins/curve_score','plugins/tcad_artifact','plugins/curve_figure_evidence')]
from tests.operations.test_m2_curve_analysis_boundary import _root,_inputs,_register_inputs,_analysis_request
from scidiscovery.artifact_agent.schema.common import canonical_json
started=time.monotonic()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='scid-transform-boundary-') as tmp:
    catalog,runtime,instance,router=_root(Path(tmp))
    values=_inputs(); report=json.loads(values['metric_report'])
    report['curve_bundle_sha256']='f'*64
    values['metric_report']=canonical_json(report)
    _register_inputs(runtime,instance,values)
    request=_analysis_request()
    admission=router.call_tool('operation_preflight',request)
    out={'operation':request['operation_id'],'probe':'transform_accepts_mismatched_input_then_calls_it_engineering_failure','preflight_admissible':admission['admissible']}
    if admission['admissible']:
        try:out['invoke_result']=router.call_tool('operation_invoke',request)
        except Exception as error:
            out['exception_type']=type(error).__name__
            out['reason']=str(error)
            out['cause']=str(error.__cause__)
            out['exception_chain']=[]
            while error is not None:
                out['exception_chain'].append({'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)})
                error=error.__cause__
    out['resources']={'elapsed_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'peak_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'address_space_limit_mib':512,'cpu_limit_seconds':30}
    Path('/tmp/scid-transform-boundary-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
